1871: async fn create_apple_password(
1872:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
1873:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
1874:     Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
1875: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
1876:     let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
1877:     if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
1878:         return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
1879:     }
1880:     let issued = accounts
1881:         .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
1882:         .await
1883:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
1884:     let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
1885:         server_url: issued.server_url,
1886:         username: issued.username,
1887:         clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
1888:         password: issued.metadata,
1889:     };
1890:     Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
1891: }

1893: async fn revoke_apple_password(
1894:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
1895:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
1896:     Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
1897: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
1898:     accounts
1899:         .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
1900:         .await
1901:         .map_err(|error| match error {
1902:             CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
1903:             other => map_caldav_error(other),
1904:         })?;
1905:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
1906: }
1907: 
1908: async fn disconnect_apple(
1909:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
1910:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
1911: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
1912:     accounts
1913:         .revoke_all(session.user.id)
1914:         .await
1915:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
1916:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
1917: }
1918: 
1919: fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
1920:     match error {
1921:         CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
1922:         CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
1923:         CaldavAuthError::ResourceExists | CaldavAuthError::UidConflict => ApiError::internal(),
1924:         CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
1925:     }
1926: }

/// Extract the resource name from a href that lives inside the given
/// collection. Returns `None` for foreign, malformed, or traversal paths.
fn href_within_collection(href: &str, principal_id: &str, calendar_id: i64) -> Option<String> {
    let prefix = format!("/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{calendar_id}/");
    let rest = href.strip_prefix(&prefix)?;
    let resource_name = rest.strip_suffix(".ics")?;
    if resource_name.is_empty() || resource_name.contains('/') {
        return None;
    }
    Some(resource_name.to_owned())
}

fn multiget_response_xml(href: &str, payload: Option<(String, String)>) -> String {
    let escaped_href = xml_escape(href);
    match payload {
        Some((etag, ical)) => {
            let escaped_ical = xml_escape(&ical);
            format!(
                r#"  <D:response>
    <D:href>{escaped_href}</D:href>
    <D:propstat>
      <D:prop>
        <D:getetag>{etag}</D:getetag>
        <D:getcontenttype>text/calendar; charset=utf-8</D:getcontenttype>
        <C:calendar-data>{escaped_ical}</C:calendar-data>
      </D:prop>
      <D:status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</D:status>
    </D:propstat>
  </D:response>"#
            )
        }
        None => format!(
            r#"  <D:response>
    <D:href>{escaped_href}</D:href>
    <D:propstat>
      <D:prop>
        <D:getetag/>
        <D:getcontenttype/>
        <C:calendar-data/>
      </D:prop>
      <D:status>HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found</D:status>
    </D:propstat>
  </D:response>"#
        ),
    }
}

fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
    let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
        authorize_calendar_action(
            UserStatus::Active,
            Some(PlatformRole::User),
            Some(role),
            action,
        ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
    };
    let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
    let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
    if can_read {
        privileges.push("DAV:read");
        privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
    }
    if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
        privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
    }
    let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
    if writable {
        privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
        privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
    }
    if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
        privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
    }
    if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
        privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
        privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
    }
    if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
        privileges.push("DAV:write");
    }
    if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
        privileges.push("DAV:all");
    }
    privileges
}

fn privilege_set_xml(privileges: &[&str]) -> String {
    let entries = privileges
        .iter()
        .map(|privilege| format!("        <D:privilege>\n          <D:href>{privilege}</D:href>\n        </D:privilege>"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("\n");
    format!(
        "      <D:current-user-privilege-set>\n{entries}\n      </D:current-user-privilege-set>"
    )
}

fn calendar_response_xml(
    accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
    principal_id: &str,
    calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
) -> String {
    let href = format!("/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{}/", calendar.calendar_id);
    let displayname = xml_escape(&calendar.name);
    let color = xml_escape(&calendar.color);
    let description = calendar
        .description
        .as_deref()
        .map(xml_escape)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let privileges = privileges_for_role(&calendar.role);
    let privilege_set = privilege_set_xml(&privileges);
    let owner_principal = calendar

        .as_ref()
        .map(|owner_principal_id| {

                "      <D:principal-URL>\n        <D:href>{}</D:href>\n      </D:principal-URL>",
                accounts.principal_url(owner_principal_id)

    let owner_block = owner_principal
        .map(|block| format!("\n{block}"))
        .unwrap_or_default();
    format!(
        r#"  <D:response>
    <D:href>{href}</D:href>
    <D:propstat>
      <D:prop>
        <D:resourcetype>
          <D:collection/>
          <C:calendar/>

          </D:report>
          <D:report>
            <D:name>sync-collection</D:name>

{privilege_set}{owner_block}

/// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event, rendered
/// at the caller's read scope. Free-busy readers receive a placeholder that
/// carries only the time window.
fn ical_and_etag(
    resource: &CaldavEventResource,
    event: &Event,
    access: DavReadAccess,
) -> Option<(String, String)> {
    let EventTiming::Timed {
        start_utc,
        end_utc,
        timezone,
    } = &event.timing
    else {
        return None;
    };
    let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
        uid: resource.uid.clone(),
        summary: event.title.clone(),
        description: event.description.clone(),
        location: event.location.clone(),
        status: Some(
            match event.status {
                EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
                EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
                EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
            }
            .to_owned(),
        ),
        start_utc: *start_utc,
        end_utc: *end_utc,
        timezone: timezone.clone(),
        dtstamp: event.created_at,
        sequence: event.version as u64,
        free_busy: matches!(access, DavReadAccess::FreeBusy),
    });
    let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
    Some((ical, etag))
}

fn render_calendar(
    accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
    principal_id: &str,
    calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
    depth: DavDepth,
    resources: &[(CaldavEventResource, String)],

        resources
            .iter()
            .map(|(resource, etag)| {

            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()

        format!(

{response}
{children}
</D:multistatus>"#
        )
    };
    (
        StatusCode::MULTI_STATUS,
        [(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/xml; charset=utf-8")],
        body,
    )
        .into_response()
}

fn xml_escape(value: &str) -> String {
    value
        .replace('&', "&")
        .replace('<', "<")
        .replace('>', ">")
        .replace('"', """)
        .replace('\'', "'")
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct CreatePasswordRequest {
    label: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct CreatePasswordResponse {
    server_url: String,
    username: String,
    clear_password: String,
    password: CredentialMetadata,
}

async fn get_apple_connection(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    let status = accounts
        .status(session.user.id)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    Ok(Json(status))
}

async fn create_apple_password(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
    Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
    if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
    }
    let issued = accounts
        .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
        server_url: issued.server_url,
        username: issued.username,
        clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
        password: issued.metadata,
    };
    Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
}

async fn revoke_apple_password(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
    Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    accounts
        .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
        .await
        .map_err(|error| match error {
            CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
            other => map_caldav_error(other),
        })?;
    Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
}

async fn disconnect_apple(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    accounts
        .revoke_all(session.user.id)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
}

fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
    match error {
        CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
        CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
        CaldavAuthError::ResourceExists | CaldavAuthError::UidConflict => ApiError::internal(),
        CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
    }
}

    async fn propfind(
        app: Router,
        uri: &str,
        username: &str,
        password: &str,
        depth: Option<&str>,
    ) -> (StatusCode, String) {
        let mut builder = Request::builder()
            .method(Method::from_bytes(b"PROPFIND").unwrap())
            .uri(uri)
            .header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
        if let Some(depth) = depth {
            builder = builder.header("depth", depth);
        }
        let request = builder.body(Body::empty()).unwrap();
        let response = app.oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
        let status = response.status();
        let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
        (status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
    }

192: fn unfold(input: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, IcsParseError> {
193:     let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
194:     for raw in input.lines() {
195:         let line = raw.strip_suffix('\r').unwrap_or(raw);
196:         if line.starts_with(' ') || line.starts_with('\t') {
197:             lines
198:                 .last_mut()
199:                 .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed))?
200:                 .push_str(&line[1..]);
201:         } else if !line.is_empty() {
202:             lines.push(line.to_owned());
203:         }
204:     }
205:     if lines.is_empty() {
206:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed));
207:     }
208:     Ok(lines)
209: }
210: fn property(line: &str) -> Result<Property, IcsParseError> {
211:     let (left, value) = line
212:         .split_once(':')
213:         .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed))?;
214:     let mut parts = left.split(';');
215:     let name = parts.next().unwrap().to_ascii_uppercase();
216:     if name.is_empty() || !name.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-') {
217:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed));
218:     }
219:     let mut params = HashMap::new();
220:     for part in parts {
221:         let (key, value) = part
222:             .split_once('=')
223:             .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed))?;
224:         if params
225:             .insert(key.to_ascii_uppercase(), value.trim_matches('"').to_owned())
226:             .is_some()
227:         {
228:             return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed));
229:         }
230:     }
231:     Ok(Property {
232:         name,
233:         params,
234:         value: value.to_owned(),
235:         raw_len: line.len(),
236:     })
237: }

239: fn normalize_event(
240:     properties: Vec<Property>,
241:     limits: IcsParserLimits,
242: ) -> Result<NormalizedEvent, IcsParseError> {
243:     let mut fields: HashMap<String, Vec<Property>> = HashMap::new();
244:     for p in properties {
245:         fields.entry(p.name.clone()).or_default().push(p);
246:     }
247:     for name in [
248:         "UID",
249:         "DTSTART",
250:         "DTEND",
251:         "DURATION",
252:         "SUMMARY",
253:         "DESCRIPTION",
254:         "LOCATION",
255:         "STATUS",
256:         "RRULE",
257:         "RECURRENCE-ID",
258:         "SEQUENCE",
259:         "DTSTAMP",
260:         "LAST-MODIFIED",
261:     ] {
262:         if fields.get(name).is_some_and(|values| values.len() > 1) {
263:             return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
264:         }
265:     }
266:     let one = |name: &str| fields.get(name).and_then(|v| v.first());
267:     let uid = text(
268:         one("UID").ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?,
269:         limits,
270:     )?;
271:     if uid.is_empty() {
272:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
273:     }
274:     let start =
275:         date_value(one("DTSTART").ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?)?;
276:     let end = one("DTEND").map(date_value).transpose()?;
277:     let duration = one("DURATION")
278:         .map(|p| parse_duration(&p.value))
279:         .transpose()?;
280:     if end.is_some() == duration.is_some() {
281:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
282:     }
283:     let timezone = one("DTSTART").and_then(|p| p.params.get("TZID")).cloned();
284:     if let Some(end_property) = one("DTEND")
285:         && end_property.params.get("TZID").cloned() != timezone
286:     {
287:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
288:     }
289:     let timing = timing(start, end, duration, timezone)?;
290:     let recurrence_id = one("RECURRENCE-ID").map(date_value).transpose()?;
291:     if recurrence_id
292:         .as_ref()
293:         .is_some_and(|v| !same_kind(v, &timing))
294:     {
295:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
296:     }
297:     let mut exdates = Vec::new();
298:     for p in fields.get("EXDATE").into_iter().flatten() {
299:         for value in p.value.split(',') {
300:             let copied = Property {
301:                 value: value.to_owned(),
302:                 ..p.clone()
303:             };
304:             let value = date_value(&copied)?;
305:             if !same_kind(&value, &timing) {
306:                 return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
307:             }
308:             exdates.push(value);
309:             if exdates.len() > limits.max_recurrence_values {
310:                 return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded));
311:             }
312:         }
313:     }
314:     let rrule = one("RRULE").map(|p| p.value.clone());
315:     if let Some(rule) = &rrule {
316:         if rule.split(';').count() > limits.max_recurrence_values {
317:             return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded));
318:         }
319:         if RecurrenceRule::parse(rule).is_err() {
320:             return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
321:         }
322:     }
323:     let status = one("STATUS").map(|p| p.value.clone());
324:     if status
325:         .as_deref()
326:         .is_some_and(|s| !matches!(s, "CONFIRMED" | "TENTATIVE" | "CANCELLED"))
327:     {
328:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
329:     }
330:     Ok(NormalizedEvent {
331:         uid,
332:         timing,
333:         summary: one("SUMMARY")
334:             .map(|p| text(p, limits))
335:             .transpose()?
336:             .unwrap_or_default(),
337:         description: one("DESCRIPTION").map(|p| text(p, limits)).transpose()?,
338:         location: one("LOCATION").map(|p| text(p, limits)).transpose()?,
339:         status,
340:         rrule,
341:         exdates,
342:         recurrence_id,
343:         sequence: one("SEQUENCE")
344:             .map(|p| p.value.parse())
345:             .transpose()
346:             .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?
347:             .unwrap_or(0),
348:         dtstamp: one("DTSTAMP").map(utc_datetime).transpose()?,
349:         last_modified: one("LAST-MODIFIED").map(utc_datetime).transpose()?,
350:     })

352: fn text(p: &Property, limits: IcsParserLimits) -> Result<String, IcsParseError> {
353:     if p.value.len() > limits.max_text_bytes {
354:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded));
355:     }
356:     let mut out = String::new();
357:     let mut escaped = false;
358:     for c in p.value.chars() {
359:         if escaped {
360:             out.push(match c {
361:                 'n' | 'N' => '\n',
362:                 '\\' => '\\',
363:                 ',' => ',',
364:                 ';' => ';',
365:                 _ => return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed)),
366:             });
367:             escaped = false;
368:         } else if c == '\\' {
369:             escaped = true;
370:         } else {
371:             out.push(c);
372:         }
373:     }
374:     if escaped || out.len() > limits.max_text_bytes {
375:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded));
376:     }
377:     Ok(out)
378: }
379: fn date_value(p: &Property) -> Result<NormalizedDateValue, IcsParseError> {
380:     if p.params.get("VALUE").is_some_and(|v| v != "DATE") {
381:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
382:     }
383:     if p.params.get("VALUE").is_some_and(|v| v == "DATE") || p.value.len() == 8 {
384:         return NaiveDate::parse_from_str(&p.value, "%Y%m%d")
385:             .map(NormalizedDateValue::AllDay)
386:             .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
387:     }
388:     let naive = NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(p.value.trim_end_matches('Z'), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
389:         .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
390:     let value = if p.value.ends_with('Z') {
391:         naive.and_utc()
392:     } else if let Some(tz) = p.params.get("TZID") {
393:         let tz: Tz = tz
394:             .parse()
395:             .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
396:         match tz.from_local_datetime(&naive) {
397:             LocalResult::Single(v) => v.with_timezone(&Utc),
398:             _ => return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent)),
399:         }
400:     } else {
401:         naive.and_utc()
402:     };
403:     Ok(NormalizedDateValue::Timed(value))
404: }
405: fn timing(
406:     start: NormalizedDateValue,
407:     end: Option<NormalizedDateValue>,
408:     duration: Option<Duration>,
409:     timezone: Option<String>,
410: ) -> Result<NormalizedTiming, IcsParseError> {
411:     match (start, end, duration) {
412:         (NormalizedDateValue::Timed(s), Some(NormalizedDateValue::Timed(e)), None) if e > s => {
413:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::Timed {
414:                 starts_at: s,
415:                 ends_at: e,
416:                 timezone,
417:             })
418:         }
419:         (NormalizedDateValue::Timed(s), None, Some(d)) if d > Duration::zero() => {
420:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::Timed {
421:                 starts_at: s,
422:                 ends_at: s + d,
423:                 timezone,
424:             })
425:         }
426:         (NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(s), Some(NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(e)), None)
427:             if e > s && timezone.is_none() =>
428:         {
429:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
430:                 start_date: s,
431:                 end_date: e,
432:             })
433:         }
434:         (NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(s), None, Some(d))
435:             if d > Duration::zero() && d.num_seconds() % 86_400 == 0 && timezone.is_none() =>
436:         {
437:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
438:                 start_date: s,
439:                 end_date: s
440:                     .checked_add_signed(d)
441:                     .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?,
442:             })
443:         }
444:         _ => Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent)),
445:     }
446: }
447: fn parse_duration(value: &str) -> Result<Duration, IcsParseError> {
448:     if !value.starts_with('P') || value.contains('-') {
449:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
450:     }
451:     let mut seconds = 0_i64;
452:     let mut n = String::new();
453:     for ch in value[1..].chars() {
454:         if ch.is_ascii_digit() {
455:             n.push(ch);
456:             continue;
457:         }
458:         if ch == 'T' {
459:             continue;
460:         }
461:         let number: i64 = n
462:             .parse()
463:             .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
464:         n.clear();
465:         seconds = seconds
466:             .checked_add(match ch {
467:                 'W' => number * 604_800,
468:                 'D' => number * 86_400,
469:                 'H' => number * 3_600,
470:                 'M' => number * 60,
471:                 'S' => number,
472:                 _ => return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent)),
473:             })
474:             .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
475:     }
476:     if !n.is_empty() || seconds <= 0 {
477:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
478:     }

574: /// Return the `.ics` resource name listed in a calendar PROPFIND response.
575: fn extract_resource_name(body: &str) -> Option<String> {
576:     for line in body.lines() {
577:         if line.contains("<D:href>") && line.contains(".ics") {
578:             let start = line.find("<D:href>")? + "<D:href>".len();
579:             let href = line[start..].trim_end().strip_suffix("</D:href>")?;
580:             let name = href.rsplit('/').next()?.strip_suffix(".ics")?;
581:             return Some(name.to_owned());
582:         }
583:     }
584:     None
585: }

1138: /// Issue a `PUT` to an existing resource with an `If-Match` precondition.
1139: async fn put_update_request(
1140:     app: Router,
1141:     uri: &str,
1142:     auth: Option<(&str, &str)>,
1143:     body: &str,
1144:     if_match: Option<&str>,
1145: ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, String) {
1146:     let mut builder = Request::builder()
1147:         .method(Method::PUT)
1148:         .uri(uri)
1149:         .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8");
1150:     if let Some((username, password)) = auth {
1151:         builder = builder.header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
1152:     }
1153:     if let Some(value) = if_match {
1154:         builder = builder.header(header::IF_MATCH, value);
1155:     }
1156:     let response = app
1157:         .oneshot(builder.body(Body::from(body.to_owned())).unwrap())
1158:         .await
1159:         .unwrap();
1160:     let status = response.status();
1161:     let headers = response.headers().clone();
1162:     let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
1163:     (status, headers, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
1164: }

DURATION:P2D
SUMMARY:All day

BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:timed@example.test

DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Budapest:20260817T110000
